properties.evidence: The earlier idea saw this coming and asked it without a number: "what does reflow2 look like at 1k / 100k / 1M tenants each holding their OWN design, and what must not be foreclosed now?" This one arrives with the number — flo2 at ~10,000 simultaneous users on different projects — and with the second half the earlier one only gestured at, namely what must not be foreclosed being the LOCAL case specifically. Direction is deliberate: the abstract question anticipated the concrete one, not the reverse.
